text:
Diego R.: Hey team — start date is 9/06. My offer mentions a $6k moving bonus and a monthly commuter stipend. Quick couple Qs: 1) Is the moving bonus paid as a single lump or can it be split? 2) I picked virtual commuter card but my first week has a company holiday — any chance it activates before the holiday? 3) I want to add my partner to health; our lease is only in their name. What docs will you accept? Thanks!

Marta (People Ops): Congrats & welcome Diego! Short answers: 1) We can usually do a lump or split the bonus across two payrolls — we need approval to split. 2) Virtual cards activate once HR marks you active and direct deposit + I-9 are clear; holidays can delay activation by a business day. 3) DP add-on: signed DP affidavit + one supporting doc (joint lease, joint bank stmt, utility) dated within 60 days. If lease is in partner's name only, affidavit + a landlord letter or joint bank stmt works.

Diego R.: I'd prefer the split if possible (moving deposits). How do I request that?

Omar (Payroll): DM me the offer ID and whether you want a 50/50 split or custom split. Payroll treats moving bonuses as supplemental wages; splitting changes withholding timing but not eligibility. If docs (I-9, W-4, direct deposit) clear by 9/01 we can include the first tranche in the next run (paid 9/15).

Diego R.: I'll DM the offer ID. About the commuter card: I uploaded direct deposit this morning but I-9 is pending. If I finish I-9 tomorrow, any chance it's active before the Thu holiday?

Marta (People Ops): If HR completes activation tomorrow and Omar confirms payroll flags, virtual card can often go live same day. Not guaranteed because of holiday processing windows, but it's likely. If you need transit cash immediately, payroll can do a one-off manual reimbursement; DM Omar with dates and receipts.

Clare (Benefits): For partner coverage: upload the signed DP affidavit plus a supporting doc. If the lease is only in partner's name we accept landlord letter (template in portal), joint bank statement, or shared utility. The landlord letter must include both names and address and be dated within 60 days. Enroll within 30 days of your start.

Diego R.: I don't have a joint bank stmt yet. I'll ask the landlord for a letter and upload the affidavit tonight. Is a scanned email from landlord acceptable?

Clare (Benefits): Scanned email is okay if it includes landlord contact info and is signed/dated. We prefer the template but will accept equivalent documentation. Once you upload, reply here and I'll expedite verification.

Omar (Payroll): FYI — commuter stipend tax treatment depends on state. Which state will you be on payroll for? DM me the state and I can run an estimated net for the bonus + stipend.

Diego R.: On payroll in OR. DMing offer ID and state now.

welcome-bot: Reminder: Complete I-9, W-4, and direct deposit within first 3 business days. Benefits enrollment window: 30 days from start. Required for DP: signed affidavit + supporting doc.

Marta (People Ops): Action items: Diego to upload landlord letter + affidavit; Diego to finish I-9; Diego to DM Omar offer ID. Clare will watch portal; Omar will run tax estimate after DM. Ping me if you need relocation split approval.

Diego R.: Thanks everyone I'll upload tonight and finish I-9 tomorrow. Appreciate the help! :raised_hands:
